verdict.rationale: Glama offers a multi-model chat and an MCP gateway that handle user data, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack has no documentation of a no-training policy or an opt-out control. 'Private by default' refers to MCP server listing visibility, not AI training use, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
